For congenital afibrinogenemia, fibrinogen replacement therapy is key. For Glanzmann's thrombasthenia, management focuses on platelet function and avoiding triggers, with potential for novel therapeutic targets related to integrin signaling.

partners.mechanism_chain: FGA/FGB/FGG (HGNC:3724) —PRODUCES→ Fibrinogen (CHEBI:57738); Fibrinogen (CHEBI:57738) —DISRUPTS→ Blood coagulation cascade (GO:0007596); Blood coagulation cascade (GO:0007596) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital afibrinogenemia (MONDO:0008737); FN1 (HGNC:3708) —PRODUCES→ Fibronectin (UniProtKB:P02751); Fibronectin (UniProtKB:P02751) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0031012); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0031012) —LEADS_TO→ Glomerulopathy with fibronectin deposits 2 (MONDO:0011165).
